args.question: Manager approval needed: this purchase order totals $3,590, which is over the $2,500 policy threshold. Lines: 5 x DK-200 USB-C Dock (new, $189 each = $945) and 5 x MN-32 32-inch 5K Monitor (new, $529 each = $2,645). Ship to HQ for the new design hires. DK-200 is in stock, so the DK-210 successor is not needed. Please have a manager approve this order. Once approved, I will place it as a single PO with the lines above, shipped to HQ. If HQ needs a specific street address, please tell me.
